steps.text: Needs engine x64-crossover26.3-r6 or later (the recipe asks for r7, which carries the same MoltenVK plus the NVAPI stub other games need): its MoltenVK accepts the linear-tiled 3D, mipmapped and array images the game creates. On every earlier engine the game exits at 98 per cent of its first load.
Leave the game on its own Vulkan renderer (the default). The graphics mode setting applies to the Rockstar launcher, which needs DXMT, not to the game.

Tested at 1280x720 windowed, set in Documents/Rockstar Games/Red Dead Redemption 2/Settings/system.xml (<screenWidth>, <screenHeight>, <windowed value="1" />) after the first run writes the file. About 34 fps in the prologue snow on an M1 Pro.
The first key after the game window regains focus is ignored. Press it again.

On a 16 GB Mac the game is memory-bound: its footprint passes 13 GB in the prologue and macOS swaps, so the frame rate decays over a minute of play. In Documents/Rockstar Games/Red Dead Redemption 2/Settings/system.xml, vSync 0 and fsr2Index 2 (FSR 2 balanced) keep the menus and cutscenes smoother and halve the GPU time there; they do not remove the memory wall. 24 GB or more removes it.

knownIssues.symptom: On engines before r6: loads to about 98 per cent, opens a window and exits without a frame (Vulkan), or crashes about 30 seconds in with DirectX 12 selected in system.xml.
knownIssues.cause: MoltenVK 1.4.1 refuses linear-tiled 3D, mipmapped and array images (fixed in r6's MoltenVK). D3DMetal answers a D3D12 call the game needs with 'Not implemented' (not fixable here).
knownIssues.fix: use engine x64-crossover26.3-r6 or later and leave the game on its default Vulkan renderer.

knownIssues.symptom: One vertex shader fails to compile to Metal (gl_CullDistance emitted into an undeclared struct member) and the driver logs many bytes_per_row assertions during loading.
knownIssues.cause: SPIRV-Cross's Metal output for cull distance, and the row pitch of the game's linear 2D textures.
knownIssues.fix: none needed so far: nothing visibly missing in the prologue. Recorded so a texture glitch later has a lead.

lastVerified.result: Vulkan (game default) with DXMT for the launcher: main menu, intro, opening cutscene and the prologue blizzard ride under keyboard control at about 34 fps, 1280x720 windowed. Zero faults in two runs.
